SELECT c.customer_code AS customerCode, c.customer_name AS customerName, SUM(ar.ar_amount) AS totalAr, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(#{statisticsDate}, ar.create_time) <= 30 THEN ar.ar_amount ELSE 0 END) AS within30, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(#{statisticsDate}, ar.create_time) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN ar.ar_amount ELSE 0 END) AS days30_60, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(#{statisticsDate}, ar.create_time) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN ar.ar_amount ELSE 0 END) AS days60_90, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(#{statisticsDate}, ar.create_time) BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN ar.ar_amount ELSE 0 END) AS days90_180, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(#{statisticsDate}, ar.create_time) > 180 THEN ar.ar_amount ELSE 0 END) AS over180, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(#{statisticsDate}, ar.create_time) > COALESCE(ar.payment_days, 30) THEN ar.ar_amount ELSE 0 END) AS overdueAmount, CASE WHEN SUM(ar.ar_amount) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(#{statisticsDate}, ar.create_time) > COALESCE(ar.payment_days, 30) THEN ar.ar_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(ar.ar_amount)) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS overdueRate FROM wms_accounts_receivable ar INNER JOIN wms_customer c ON ar.customer_id = c.id WHERE ar.del_flag = 0 AND c.del_flag = 0 AND ar.ar_status = '0'
AND ar.customer_id IN
#{id}
GROUP BY c.id, c.customer_code, c.customer_name HAVING SUM(ar.ar_amount) > 0 ORDER BY totalAr DESC
